text: The assigned first patch adds hexadecimal constraints and interactive delayed fingerprint truncation. Available Bug discussion says the later approach normalizes at save time after a test-fixture backout; the first landing must stay historical. Fixed openPgpExternalComplete calls normalizeKeyInput, checks for a matching public key/user email, then stores the key ID and calls okExternalCallback. Its markup now accepts key IDs and longer fingerprint forms. This inspection does not establish every normalizer/GPGME behavior or real key validity. Bug comment1 is unavailable and review is deferred; no OpenPGP test ran.
title: External GnuPG key input validation is separate from saving its normalized value
